name: Commune With Spirit
body:
School divination; Level bloodlord 3, druid 3, shaman 3, witch 3

Casting Time 10 minutes

Components V, S, M (incense and an offering of 10 gp)

Range 10 ft.

Target spirit nearby

Duration 1 min./level

Saving Throw Will negates, partial; Spell Resistance no

You contact a local spirit inhabiting the world or objects around you. You can ask the spirit one question per two caster levels. If you do not know a specific spirit in the area, you contact a random spirit. If the spirit is unwilling, you must make a Will save against the DC of this spell before getting it to cooperate. The spirit’s knowledge is limited to its immediate area and will typically answer in one-word answers. However, if the one word would be misleading or contrary to the spirit’s interests, the spirit can respond with a short phrase (five words or less) instead.

If you do not know a spirit is nearby for you to contact, there is a 50% chance there is no spirit and the spell fails.

If a spirit has been subject to commune with spirit within the past week, the new spell fails.
